recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit historical R4/R4B generated history artifacts for this R5-applied change; future item-control code changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack unless core regains ownership.
issue_request: FHIR-20944 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire change request to remove the redundant `atable` code from the questionnaire item-control code list for R5.
initial_application: Jira records commit b1331bbb1e, which removed the complete `atable` concept from `source/questionnaire/codesystem-questionnaire-item-control.xml` on 2021-03-23.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread supports the redundancy rationale. The old core CodeSystem file was later deleted by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 during R5 extension-source cleanup. Current core `source/fhir.ini` has Questionnaire active but no active `questionnaire-item-control` CodeSystem or ValueSet entry, and the active item-control CodeSystem now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack without `atable`. Remaining `atable` hits in the FHIR checkout are R4/R4B history files, not current source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source already reflects the requested removal and no in-scope core source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: Jira search found this separate SDC/grid itemControl amendment mentioning `atable`, but it concerns the `grid` code rather than the FHIR-20944 removal and was not decided here.
The related grid addition touched the same CodeSystem after `atable` was removed and is already represented separately on the combined branch.
